question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**immediately**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**immediately**'.
 
• It means** 'at once; without delay'.** (तुरंत; अविलंब)
 
 
• *Example: Can you come home **immediately** after work?*
 
 
 
• Here, the most appropriate word is '**immediately**' because if something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Namita did not have enough cash. She did not __have__ a credit card either. She found herself in a __fix__. She had the contact number of a __close__ friend whom she called for help. Her friend came **__immediately__ **and settled the bill. Namita thanked her and expressed her (5) _______ . She promised to return the money to her friend soon.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **purposely**: with a particular intention. (विशेष इरादे से)
 
• **regularly**: with a constant or definite pattern, especially with the same space between individual items. (नियमित रूप से, नियत अंतराल पर)
 
• **slowly**: at a slow speed; not quickly. (मंद गति से; जल्‍दी नहीं, धीरे-धीरे)

The correct answer is '**gratitude**'.
